newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares shed 4.13 pct on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares shed 4.13 pct on political uncertainty.

text.p: Heavy selling triggered by political uncertainty resulting from a stand-off between India's Home Minister and the governor of the most populous Uttar Pradesh state drove down Delhi Shares on Monday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 34.17 points, or 4.13 percent, lower at 794.16 points.
